newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 15.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Some three hundred judges sign a letter to President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Lionel Jospin calling for improved moral standards to be applied to democratic government.
-- Prospect of a "weak" euro drives dollar above six francs, as markets ponder the ability of France and Germany to bring their public deficits down to a strict three percent of GDP this year.
